about.title: Who are we?
about.subtitle: Two young people from Jerez bringing together technology and equestrian know-how.
about.p1: We are two guys from Jerez de la Frontera, a land where the horse is far more than a tradition. Growing up here has let us learn first-hand how stud farms work and what their real day-to-day problems are.
about.p2: Relincho was born as the perfect combination of our two passions. One of us is a Software Engineer, responsible for the entire technical architecture so the platform is modern, fast and secure.
about.p3: The other is immersed in studies of Physiotherapy and Sports Science. Thanks to this, we bring deep technical knowledge about the horse's musculature, its recovery and the different types of training, carrying all that scientific rigour into the software.

local.description: Being from Jerez, we know first-hand the land, the culture and what the horse world really needs day to day.

items.question: What is Relincho and who is it for?
items.answer: Relincho is comprehensive management software designed for stud farms, equestrian centres, riding schools and equine professionals who want to digitise and simplify their day to day. From health to invoicing, all on a single platform.

items.question: Do I need technical knowledge to use the platform?
items.answer: Not at all. We designed Relincho with a clean, intuitive and easy-to-use interface. Our goal is for anyone to be able to start managing their horses from the very first minute, with no need for complex manuals.

items.question: Is my data and my clients' data safe?
items.answer: Yes. We use the highest cloud security standards. Your data and your clients' data are encrypted and we run automatic backups constantly so you never lose important information.

items.question: Does it comply with invoicing regulations and Veri*Factu?
items.answer: Completely. Our invoicing module is up to date and adapted to the new AEAT regulations (including Veri*Factu). You can issue legal invoices, generate recurring fees and automate SEPA direct debits without worry.

items.question: Can I try Relincho before subscribing?
items.answer: Of course! We understand you want to make sure Relincho is the perfect tool for you. We offer a trial where you can explore all the key features and discover how we can help you optimise your equestrian centre.

s1.title: 1. Information we collect
s1.intro: At Relincho, we collect information to provide better services to all our users. This includes:
items: Personal information you provide to us (name, email, billing details).
Data about your horses, facilities and clients that you enter into the software.
Platform usage information and cookies (see Cookie Policy).

s2.title: 2. How we use your data
s2.intro: We use the information collected to:
items: Provide, maintain and improve our management software.
Send you important notifications about the service and technical support.
Comply with applicable law (including invoicing regulations).

s3.title: 3. Sharing your data
s3.body: We do not sell your personal data to third parties. We only share information with essential service providers (such as payment platforms and cloud hosting) that comply with GDPR security standards, and where required by law.

s4.title: 4. Data security
s4.body: Your data is encrypted and stored on secure servers. We run regular backups to guarantee the integrity and availability of your stud farm or equestrian centre's information.

s5.title: 5. Your rights
s5.body: You have the right to access, rectify or delete your personal data at any time. To exercise these rights, contact us at privacidad@relincho.com.

s1.title: 1. What are cookies?
s1.body: A cookie is a small text file that a website saves on your computer or mobile device when you visit it. It lets the website remember your actions and preferences (such as sign-in, language and other display preferences) for a period of time.

s2.title: 2. How we use cookies at Relincho
s2.intro: We use cookies for several reasons, mainly to:

items.description: Essential for you to browse the platform and use its features, such as accessing secure areas (signing in to your account).
Help us understand how visitors interact with the site, collecting information anonymously.
Allow the website to remember the choices you make (such as your username).

s3.title: 3. Controlling cookies
s3.body: You can control and/or delete cookies as you wish. You can delete all cookies already on your computer and you can set most browsers to prevent them from being installed. However, if you do this, you may have to manually adjust some preferences every time you visit a site, and some services and features (such as access to your account) may not work.
